title: Initiation of Programmed Cell Death in Cancer Stem Cells: In Silico Mutagenesis for Optimized TRAIL-DR5 Binding with Perplexity AI

contributions.purpose: 提出透明可复现的TRAIL-DR5结合优化计算流水线
contributions.mechanism: PyMOL/APBS表面电位与疏水性映射→界面残基理性突变→HDOCK对接
contributions.evaluation: WT/静电突变/疏水突变3变体对接比较(标准参数)
contributions.domain: 计算蛋白工程/癌症干细胞凋亡
contributions.source_quote: This study presents a transparent, fully reproducible computational pipeline that automates surface mapping, rational mutagenesis, and docking to optimize TRAIL-DR5 binding.

contributions.purpose: 声称疏水界面富集给出最大结合亲和力提升
contributions.mechanism: 疏水vs静电vs WT对接打分与置信度比较
contributions.evaluation: 声称疏水最大提升8.41%、置信度93.8%(但与Table1矛盾,见notes)
contributions.source_quote: hydrophobic interface enrichment consistently produced the largest binding affinity gains over wild-type TRAIL, with a maximum improvement of 8.41% and model confidence reaching 93.8%.
